location: Hòa Minh 19, P. Hòa Minh, TP. Đà Nẵng
content: Gạo Lứt House draws inspiration from the story of a young family living and working in Đà Nẵng. The name "Gạo Lứt" refers both to nutritious brown rice and its rustic beauty, and to the family's affectionate nickname for their daughter. The image of rice grains shimmering at night became the project's central motif, symbolizing light, health, peace, and the love that fills the family home.
